gen-dafont-neuropolitical-fs-amulya: Neon-tube letters, pulled apart and glowing with a single stroke width. Neuropolitical stands tall in the lowercase, Amulya sits lower as a sans-serif, and that height gap is the real story.
gen-dafont-neuropolitical-fs-synonym: Neuropolitical glows like neon tubing, every letter pulled apart. Synonym, a sans-serif with constant ink and generous curve openings, keeps going down the page with dependable ease, never tiring the eye.
gen-dafont-plakkaat-sora: Heavy bent-straw lines with sweeping terminals curling toward the stem. Plakkaat hits hardest in tall, loud lowercase, while Sora, a precise sans, turns corners cleanly without any pressure swell.
gen-dafont-starborn-gf-quando: Dreamy, drifting letters with wide gulfs of blank space. Starborn earns its keep big and short, where that thick lowercase stripe glows, while Quando, a serif, adds bookish, widely spaced tradition.
gen-dafont-starborn-plus-jakarta-sans: Ethereal Starborn drifts apart, thick and dark across each line. Plus Jakarta Sans, a monoline sans-serif with curve endings held well apart, moves down a full column with modern precision.
gen-dafont-stencilia-gf-almendra: Stencilia hits like a cut stencil, gaps at every curve end. Almendra brings a deep, dignified, bookish lowercase that gives the compact, structural heading something stately to lean against.
gen-dafont-stencilia-space-grotesk: Space Grotesk draws each glyph as a ribbon of constant width. Stencilia stands tall and structural with spacious curve gaps, and that jump in height over the moderate body is the standout.
gen-eater-gf-basic: Basic reads clean and professional, a gentle bump up to capitals. Eater, the dark display heading, sets wide gaps between letters and swings mellowly in weight, a jolt against this sans-serif.
gen-eater-gf-geom: Eater sits halfway between monoline strokes and razor-thin hairlines. Geom, a sans-serif with a lofty lowercase band, hands that dark, aggressive heading an approachable, contemporary counterweight, and the mood gap is the point.
gen-eater-gf-magra: Dark and aggressive, Eater puts wide gaps between letters, short ascenders and a modest dip in the thin strokes. Magra hits back with big-bodied, neutral lowercase words in every line.
